findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_endpoint, fetch_webpage, fetch_webpage_pro, search_images, search_places, youtube_transcript, get_contents, compare_urls, batch_fetch, detect_tech, search_discussions · Private data: extract_pdf, domain_intel · Public sink: monitor_create · Destructive: preview_endpoint, deep_research, detect_tech.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_endpoint, fetch_webpage, fetch_webpage_pro, search_images, search_places, youtube_transcript, get_contents, compare_urls, batch_fetch, detect_tech, search_discussions · Private data: extract_pdf, domain_intel · Public sink: monitor_create · Destructive: preview_endpoint, deep_research, detect_tech

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
